me.title: Identity
me.p1: Eloi Chicoine, second-year student in Multimedia and Internet (BUT MMI) in Limoges.
me.p2: Before MMI, I spent a year in PASS (health studies) after a science baccalaureate in maths and physics-chemistry with advanced maths. I kept a taste for method, which I now put to work on images.
me.p3: Outside class: video games, films and series, photography, music.
